description: Origins after affects keeps where a change of one fact enters, the steps it reaches that rest on no step it reaches
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
subtotal = price * qty
tax = subtotal * 0.2
total = subtotal + tax
price |> affects |> origins |> nodes

description: Outcomes after affects keeps where a change of one fact ends, the steps it reaches that no step it reaches rests on
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
subtotal = price * qty
tax = subtotal * 0.2
total = subtotal + tax
price |> affects |> outcomes |> nodes

description: Origins and outcomes of the model are its sources and its sinks
code:
rate = 0.2
price = 10
qty = 3
subtotal = price * qty
tax = subtotal * rate
shipping = qty * 2
[model |> origins |> nodes, model |> outcomes |> nodes]

description: Outcomes of an explanation without a cycle is the explained value alone, and its origins are the facts it starts from
code:
a = 1
b = a + 2
c = b * 2
d = c + a
[d |> why |> outcomes |> nodes, d |> why |> origins |> nodes]

description: Origins keeps the inputs that a class governs, which stated leaves out
code:
fee = 2
class Order(price, qty):
    this.price = price
    this.qty = qty
$Order.total = $Order.price * $Order.qty + fee
first = Order(10, 2)
[first.total |> why |> origins |> nodes, first.total |> why |> stated |> nodes]

description: Outcomes follows the chains through the steps that a filter dropped
code:
price = 10
quantity = 3
rate = 0.2
subtotal = price * quantity
tax = subtotal * rate
total = subtotal + tax
total |> why |> except(subtotal) |> outcomes |> nodes

description: Origins after depth keeps the first conclusions within the limit
code:
price = 10
quantity = 3
rate = 0.2
subtotal = price * quantity
tax = subtotal * rate
total = subtotal + tax
total |> why |> depth(1) |> origins |> nodes

description: A derived value whose only input was deleted rests on no step and is an origin
code:
a = 1
b = a * 2
c = b + 1
delete a
model |> origins |> nodes

description: A standing outcomes declaration follows a new dependent of its outcome
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
subtotal = price * qty
ends = price |> affects |> outcomes
total = subtotal + 5
grand = total * 2
ends.map(step -> step.node)

description: Outcomes of a union keeps the ends of both explanations
code:
price = 10
quantity = 3
rate = 0.5
subtotal = price * quantity
tax = subtotal * rate
shipping = quantity * 2
tax |> why |> union(shipping |> why) |> outcomes |> nodes

description: A class-level rule keeps where a change of each instance's cost ends
code:
class Part(cost):
    this.cost = cost
$Part.price = $Part.cost * 2
$Part.label = "$" + $Part.price
$Part.ends = $Part.cost |> affects |> outcomes
bolt = Part(3)
nut = Part(4)
[bolt.ends.map(step -> step.node), nut.ends.map(step -> step.holds)]

description: A binding named origins shadows the stage, and a try catches the error
code:
a = 1
b = a + 1
origins = 5
try:
    found = b |> why |> origins
catch error:
    found = error
[found, b |> why |> outcomes |> nodes]
